'''Tresk''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Vessel (cyborg)|vessel]] who worked for [[Wonn Ionstrike/Legends|Wonn Ionstrike's]] [[Lenushaa gang]]. He stole information from an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] cell on [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]] and tried to pass it onto [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Velantia]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].
